about_the_game:
Online Massive Multiplayer

Play with friends, meet new people, conquer dungeons together and share stories.

A massive world awaits you, full of life and adventures. Discover new areas with your party, and get stronger together. Dynamic world events pull players together, to defeat bosses and challenging missions: Every player makes a difference.

Obsydian is also known for its huge and stable economy, together with the player-based "Trading Hall" where you can buy and sell tradeable items for coins.

Skill and Movement based Combat

Master a fluid, responsive combat system, with creative ways to move around the map, and to slash monsters.

Free-flowing dynamic combat where strategic positioning and your skill amplify your stats and build choices. Jump over enemy swings, dodge missiles, and attack from the air.

Near-Infinite Build Potential

Games tend to fall into one of two extremes: They either offer great build variety but are overly complex and filled with too many sub-systems, or they lack depth entirely.

We keep stat affixes simple to understand, and offer a gigantic amount of them, each being important in its own way for build-crafting.

Choose your path through the class and mastery tree. Each class comes with their unique masteries, that define your build's focus and synergies. There’s always something new to try!

Gemstones can be socketed into weapons to define their attack rules, and behaviour. Burst dozends of poison arrows, incinerate monsters, or spread sickness.

Horizontal and Vertical Progression

Obsydian focuses on horizontal progression, making all content relevant, not just the newest.

Mixed with vertical stat-progression from popular ARPG's and deep build strategies we created an unique and very rewarding experience, making your progress relevant forever.

Loot, Grow, and Evolve

Collect and craft powerful gear, unlock permanent upgrades, and evolve through the web of individual skills and attributes each class has.

There is no upwards level scaling in Obsydian, you are as strong as your gear and build is. Going into lower level areas does adjust your character's base strength, so every piece of content stays relevant for the whole time. 

Explore the Huge World of Obsydian

A truly living and dynamic world.

The overworld is 100% handcrafted, and each zone offers procedurally generated caves, catacombs and more.

With a smooth mix between both approaches, we keep the whole lore of this world in tact, while offering new and fresh experiences through randomized dungeons.

But even the Overworld is dynamic, offering Events where players collect to conquer one big challenge together.

Every world brings new trials: Unique quests, deadly encounters, and colossal bosses with their own attack patterns and bullet-hell-like fury. Learn their moves and adapt your build to carve your name into their flesh.

Key Features:

  • Horizontal Progression, mixed with vertical stat-progression known from classic ARPG's

  • Handcrafted, detailed worlds merged with random generated dungeons

  • Extremely deep build variety and progression system, simple to understand

  • An indistinguishable, rich fantasy atmosphere, and immersive worlds

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD Phenom II X4 970
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 250, 1 GB / AMD Radeon HD 6670, 1 GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB / AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A classic MMORPG experience, modernized the right way. Near-endless build creation and deep character development. Explore the living world of myth, craft legendary gear, slash through monsters, and loot as much you can.
